name: finanzas-personales
description: Personal finances without an app: import Mexican bank statements, categories that learn as rules, cash in a sentence, budgets with history, card payment reminders and monthly close.

stays_local: card numbers, account numbers and CLABE
names and accounts of the people the owner transfers to
tracking keys, references and transfer concepts
the memory file (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
agent_sees: merchant, amount and date of each transaction
pseudonyms instead of accounts and people (ACC_…, PERSONA_…)
product name and last 4 digits of the account (omitted with mxbank --privacy strict)
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: the rule not to open PDFs is an instruction to the agent; a host permission reduces the risk but does not remove it
what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms
the memory file is not encrypted
